name: Old money
setupLines: Benign passes the bread. Malign passes judgement.
"Lovely to see everyone," says Gentle, to the four people she's sure about.
Someone has been creeping past this table all evening, very, very carefully.

gentle: Gentle says he's no cousin of hers. Ask her how she knows.
Gentle keeps the family tree. She's crossed one name out in pencil.
Gentle has been very gentle about it. Ask her anyway.
benign: Benign noticed something. Benign notices everything, kindly.
Ask Benign. She remembers him before he got so careful.
Benign won't gossip. Ask her twice.
malign: Malign has a theory. Malign always has a theory.
Ask Malign. You'll regret it, but ask.
Malign has written one word on his napkin and underlined it.
nature: Nature has seen every birth at this reunion except one.
Ask Nature. She's very old and very blunt.
Nature is asking for birth certificates. One guest left the room.
engine: Engine has worked out how he got here. Probably.
Ask Engine. He's been drawing diagrams on the tablecloth.
Engine says the parts fit. Engine says that about everything.
